summary:
Implemented opt-in English stopword filtering for top_words() and `textkit stats --stopwords LANG` exactly as the plan specifies, following its order of work and writing each test before its implementation.

Files changed:
- src/textkit/stopwords.py (new): English frozenset of 30 lower-case ASCII words (includes the/on/of/and, excludes cat/sat/mat), STOPWORDS registry {"en": ...}, stopwords_for(language) raising ValueError "unsupported stopword language: 'xx' (supported: en)" on unknown codes; module docstring states the list was written for this repo, not copied, and is covered by the repo licence.
- src/textkit/stats.py: imports stopwords_for; top_words(text, n, *, stopwords=None) validates the code before the n<=0 early return, lower-cases tokens as before, drops excluded words before counting/truncation. word_count/char_count/_tokens/_TOKEN untouched.
- src/textkit/cli.py: stats subparser gains --stopwords (metavar LANG); _format_stats(text, *, stopwords=None) forwards to top_words; main() reads the file outside the try, wraps _format_stats in try/except ValueError -> parser.error (exit 2).
- src/textkit/__init__.py: re-exports stopwords_for and adds it to __all__.
- tests/test_stopwords.py (new, 2 tests), tests/test_stats.py (added `import pytest` + 6 tests), tests/test_cli.py (3 tests appended). All existing tests left byte-for-byte unchanged.
- README.md: new paragraph after the CLI sentence documenting the option, `en` as the only language, off by default, exit 2 on other codes, list location, and that counts are never filtered.
- work/13/plan.md: corrected inaccurate predictions (see deviations). No changes to pyproject.toml, uv.lock, Makefile, factory.toml, or protected paths.

Red/green sequence actually observed:
1. `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_stopwords.py` -> ImportError: cannot import name 'stopwords_for' (before), 2 passed (after stopwords.py + re-export).
2. `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_stats.py` -> 6 failed / 6 passed, all six failures `TypeError: top_words() got an unexpected keyword argument 'stopwords'` (before); 12 passed (after).
3. `uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_cli.py` -> 2 failed / 5 passed, failures `SystemExit: 2` from `unrecognized arguments: --stopwords en` (before); 7 passed (after). The third new test already passed before the CLI change because argparse's unknown-option error is also exit 2 and names `xx`.

Proof and checks run, all green:
- `make test` -> "30 passed in 0.29s", exit 0.
- `make lint` -> "All checks passed!", exit 0.
- `uv run --frozen --offline pytest` -> 30 passed.
- `uv run --frozen textkit stats /tmp/tk.txt --stopwords en` (file = "the cat sat on the mat the cat", written with the Write tool) -> "words: 8 / chars: 30 / top: /   cat: 2 /   mat: 1 /   sat: 1", exit 0.
- `uv run --frozen textkit stats /tmp/tk.txt` -> "words: 8 / chars: 30 / top: /   the: 3 /   cat: 2 /   mat: 1", exit 0.
- `uv run --frozen textkit stats /tmp/tk.txt --stopwords xx` -> exit 2, stderr "usage: textkit [-h] {slug,stats} ..." then "textkit: error: unsupported stopword language: 'xx' (supported: en)".
- grep of README.md shows the paragraph naming `--stopwords en`, `en` as the only language, and "off by default"; head of src/textkit/stopwords.py shows the authorship/licence docstring.

Not run: `git status --porcelain -- pyproject.toml uv.lock`. The harness denied every `git` invocation (and the prompt forbids git commands). Neither file was opened or edited in this session, so they are untouched; the factory's diff should confirm.
deviations: Plan step 3 / proof table said 'the five stopwords= tests fail with TypeError' before top_words() is changed; in fact all six new tests in tests/test_stats.py pass stopwords= and all six failed. Implementation is unchanged; corrected the wording in work/13/plan.md.

Plan step 5 / proof table said all three new tests/test_cli.py tests fail before the CLI change; only two did. test_stats_command_rejects_unknown_stopword_language already passed because argparse rejects the unknown --stopwords option with exit 2 and echoes 'xx' in stderr. Test kept verbatim as the plan wrote it; corrected the prediction in work/13/plan.md and noted that step 6 makes it pass for the intended reason.
Plan proof row for `make test` said '3 test files, 22 tests'; the suite is 4 files (tests/test_slug.py already exists) and 30 tests (19 baseline + 11 new). Corrected the count in work/13/plan.md.

Plan step 9 / proof row `git status --porcelain -- pyproject.toml uv.lock` was not executed: the build role's tooling denies `git` and the prompt forbids it. Neither file was touched. Amended work/13/plan.md to say the factory/reviewer runs that check.
